mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q01.stem: After a measure, also check for new trip hazards.
reasons: True is correct. A measure can reduce the original hazard while creating another.
False is inappropriate. A measure can reduce the original hazard while creating another.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q02.stem: Predetermined thickness-measurement locations help compare lots.
reasons: True is correct. Using the same locations reduces position-related differences.
False is inappropriate. Using the same locations reduces position-related differences.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q03.stem: Points within control limits automatically prove every product meets specifications.
reasons: True is incorrect. An in-limit process point alone cannot guarantee each product's conformity.
False is correct. An in-limit process point alone cannot guarantee each product's conformity.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q04.stem: Distinguish zincate pretreatment from main plating.
reasons: True is correct. Zincating is pretreatment relating to later adhesion and similar functions.
False is inappropriate. Zincating is pretreatment relating to later adhesion and similar functions.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q05.stem: A stopped machine permits entry without checking stored energy.
reasons: True is incorrect. Stopping alone prevents neither residual energy nor restart.
False is correct. Stopping alone prevents neither residual energy nor restart.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q06.stem: When calculations disagree, change records to convenient measured values.
reasons: True is incorrect. Do not alter actual measurements to fit a calculation.
False is correct. Do not alter actual measurements to fit a calculation.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q07.stem: Liquid properties after neutralization depend on combinations and amounts.
reasons: True is correct. Reacting types and quantities change remaining constituents.
False is inappropriate. Reacting types and quantities change remaining constituents.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q08.stem: Masking requires checks of protected areas and material compatibility.
reasons: True is correct. Match the untreated areas with chemical and heat resistance.
False is inappropriate. Match the untreated areas with chemical and heat resistance.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q09.stem: Changing only to finishing conditions always removes deep scratches automatically.
reasons: True is incorrect. Fine finishing does not guarantee automatic removal of deep scratches.
False is correct. Fine finishing does not guarantee automatic removal of deep scratches.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q10.stem: Clarity automatically returns every constituent to its control range.
reasons: True is incorrect. Clarity alone cannot reveal every dissolved constituent's amount.
False is correct. Clarity alone cannot reveal every dissolved constituent's amount.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q11.stem: The classification salt alone cannot establish harmlessness.
reasons: True is correct. Formula classification and hazards require separate checks.
False is inappropriate. Formula classification and hazards require separate checks.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q12.stem: A defect increase at shift change proves the operator caused it.
reasons: True is incorrect. Use facts to check machines, materials and methods as well as people.
False is correct. Use facts to check machines, materials and methods as well as people.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q13.stem: Warning signs indicate hazards rather than physically removing them.
reasons: True is correct. A sign supplies information; it does not remove the hazard itself.
False is inappropriate. A sign supplies information; it does not remove the hazard itself.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q14.stem: Darker black conversion films always resist corrosion better in every environment.
reasons: True is incorrect. Color intensity alone determines neither thickness nor overall protection.
False is correct. Color intensity alone determines neither thickness nor overall protection.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q15.stem: Powders also need controls for dust, ignition and heat.
reasons: True is correct. Absence of solvent does not remove dust, fire or thermal hazards.
False is inappropriate. Absence of solvent does not remove dust, fire or thermal hazards.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q16.stem: A clamp meter reads correctly around any number of conductors together.
reasons: True is incorrect. Check the target conductor and AC/DC compatibility through the procedure.
False is correct. Check the target conductor and AC/DC compatibility through the procedure.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q17.stem: Record moisture and packaging condition during corrosion investigation.
reasons: True is correct. They affect the presence or retention of an electrolyte.
False is inappropriate. They affect the presence or retention of an electrolyte.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q18.stem: Unexpected precipitation in a production tank calls for abnormality investigation.
reasons: True is correct. Unexpected formation informs investigation of changed conditions or contamination.
False is inappropriate. Unexpected formation informs investigation of changed conditions or contamination.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q19.stem: Identifying hazards in KYT makes guards unnecessary.
reasons: True is incorrect. Discussion and attention reminders do not replace necessary equipment guarding.
False is correct. Discussion and attention reminders do not replace necessary equipment guarding.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q20.stem: A discolored reference sample remains identical to its approved state forever.
reasons: True is incorrect. A discolored reference cannot guarantee the originally approved color.
False is correct. A discolored reference cannot guarantee the originally approved color.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q21.stem: Estimate mass from density and actual material volume.
reasons: True is correct. Mass equals density multiplied by the actual material volume.
False is inappropriate. Mass equals density multiplied by the actual material volume.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q22.stem: Conductor length and cross-section affect overall resistance.
reasons: True is correct. Even for the same material, path length and area affect resistance.
False is inappropriate. Even for the same material, path length and area affect resistance.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q23.stem: Representative withstand voltage permits unconditional human-protection insulation use.
reasons: True is incorrect. Evaluation must also consider defects, shape and environment.
False is correct. Evaluation must also consider defects, shape and environment.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q24.stem: Chromium species matter to product requirements and controls.
reasons: True is correct. Do not equate hexavalent and trivalent forms' hazards or performance.
False is inappropriate. Do not equate hexavalent and trivalent forms' hazards or performance.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q25.stem: Inspectors may freely choose the most favorable lighting.
reasons: True is incorrect. Arbitrary lighting cannot establish conformity under specified conditions.
False is correct. Arbitrary lighting cannot establish conformity under specified conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q26.stem: Two parts with similar masses always have identical material.
reasons: True is incorrect. Similar mass alone proves neither composition nor identity.
False is correct. Similar mass alone proves neither composition nor identity.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q27.stem: ISO9001 and ISO14001 address different management subjects.
reasons: True is correct. 9001 concerns quality and 14001 environmental management.
False is inappropriate. 9001 concerns quality and 14001 environmental management.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q28.stem: Reporting, communication and consultation must wait until causes are completely established.
reasons: True is incorrect. Separate observed facts from uncertain causes and share promptly.
False is correct. Separate observed facts from uncertain causes and share promptly.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q29.stem: Rinse water is uncontrolled and can be discharged anywhere.
reasons: True is incorrect. Chemicals and metal constituents can transfer into rinse water.
False is correct. Chemicals and metal constituents can transfer into rinse water.

mfg1-surface-mock-04-theory-q30.stem: Aluminium anodizing forms oxide from the workpiece surface.
reasons: True is correct. Oxidation of the substrate surface creates an oxide layer.
False is inappropriate. Oxidation of the substrate surface creates an oxide layer.
